text: Healthy living is about taking care of your body and mind. A balanced diet with plenty of fruit, vegetables and water gives you energy and helps you stay well. Regular exercise, such as walking or swimming, keeps your body strong and reduces stress. Good sleep is also important, because it helps your brain and body recover. Don't forget your mental health: talk to friends and family when you feel worried. Finally, try to keep a good work-life balance. Make time for rest and hobbies, and don't spend all your time working. Small daily habits can make a big difference to your health.
